Job Title: Accountant
Experience: 4-7 years
Location: Fully remote within India.

Mandatory Skills:
- Tally
- Microsoft Excel
- TDS
- GST

Good to have:
- IFRS
- Financial Modeling
- SAP FICO
- Accounts Payable

About the company:
A rapidly growing mid-sized financial services firm that provides outsourced accounting, compliance, and financial reporting solutions to startups and SMEs across India. The company emphasizes process-driven work, timely statutory compliance, and automation of routine accounting tasks to deliver accurate month-end closings and regulatory filings.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain books of accounts for multiple client entities using Tally, ensuring timely and accurate recording of all financial transactions.
- Prepare and manage GST returns, reconcile GST ledgers, and support GST audits and queries.
- Compute, deduct, deposit, and file TDS returns in compliance with statutory timelines; reconcile TDS with client records and Form 26AS.
- Perform month-end and year-end closing activities, prepare trial balances, reconciliations, and basic financial statements.
- Use Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reconciliations, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and preparation of management reports.
- Liaise with clients to collect supporting documentation, clarify transactions, and resolve discrepancies.
- Support internal process improvements and documentation to streamline accounting workflows and ensure audit readiness.
- Coordinate with outsourced payroll, accounts payable, and tax consultants as required to ensure end-to-end accounting operations.
- Ensure adherence to statutory compliance calendars and assist in statutory audits and tax assessments.

Candidate profile:
- Proven track record handling full-spectrum accounting tasks (billing, ledgers, reconciliations, GST, TDS) for multiple clients.
- Strong proficiency in Tally and advanced skills in Microsoft Excel.
- Good understanding of Indian taxation (GST and TDS) and compliance requirements.
- Detail-oriented, process-driven, able to manage deadlines across multiple accounts in a remote work environment.
- Good communication skills to interact with clients and internal stakeholders.

Perks:
- Fully remote role with flexible working hours.
- Exposure to varied client industries and opportunities to upskill in IFRS, financial modeling, and ERP systems like SAP FICO.
- Supportive team with emphasis on learning and career growth.
